items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Well, she had Phil Moore. I think Phil played for her awhile... Then Phil Moore worked with her for awhile, but he had other commitments.

ctx.x: Who was backing Lena at that point?

Well, she had Phil Moore. I think Phil played for her awhile, and then Eddie Beal. Eddie Beal played for her first and then Phil Moore came in and accompanied her, and of course she was -- I'm trying to remember which of the bands was there. It was Matty -- is it Matty?
